_comment: The vendored KaTeX bytes, pinned. katex.min.js and LICENSE were compared byte for byte with the published katex@0.16.9 package (unpkg.com/katex@0.16.9) on 2026-10-12 and are identical; katex.inline.css is derived from the package's stylesheet by build/vendor-katex.mjs (fonts inlined), so its hash pins this repository's derivation, not the publisher's bytes. Checked by build/check-vendored.mjs.
